detail.longDescription: I don't know where to start to solve this, hopefully someone can help point me in a direction: I host a # Immich instance on my # Debian server. I simply followed their docs to set it up with # Docker Compose. Everything works perfectly on my local network, but when I connect via # Wireguard VPN, I cannot connect to Immich. I can connect to Jellyfin, Samba, Obsidian LiveSync even through the Wireguard VPN, so I am a bit confused. Any pointers would be appreciated! # SelfHosting
